units.source_text: 汤波半是家有两百多年历史的老铺子，还留下了战火的痕迹。

en.t: Yubahan is an old shop with more than two hundred years of history, and it still bears traces of the wartime fires.

units.source_text: 有的地方经过修整，比如在小天窗上安了玻璃，像火炕一般的做豆皮用的炉子，则改用砖砌。

en.t: Some parts had been repaired; for example, glass had been fitted into the small skylight, and the stove used for making yuba, which was like a heated brick bed, had been rebuilt in brick.
